records.title: Email to Loosemores (successor to John Loosemore & Co.) (26 May 2026)
records.description: Public-safe extract of a sent email to Loosemores on 26 May 2026 requesting preservation of surviving archival material concerning Great House Farm and BP Properties Ltd v Buckler.

provenance.holder: Cedwyn email archive (read-only export of the family mailbox)

records.transcript_status: public-safe extract; personal context and contact details omitted
records.transcript:
Sirs / Madam,

I am a family descendant connected to Great House Farm, Llandough, Vale of Glamorgan, and an heir of the family historically associated with the property.

I am researching historical litigation and events surrounding Great House Farm, Llandough, including BP Properties Ltd v Buckler [1987] EWCA Civ 2 and earlier proceedings.

I would be grateful if your firm could check whether any archived material survives, including case files, attendance notes, instructions / briefs, witness statements, counsel papers, title investigations, deeds packets, land correspondence, licence letters, photographs, maps / plans, press files, internal memoranda, storage references, archive indexes and destruction schedules / logs.

I understand retention periods may have expired. If files no longer exist, I would be grateful for confirmation of whether records once existed, the approximate destruction date, the retention policy applied and any successor archive location or off-site storage reference.

I am not asserting conclusions as established fact; I am seeking evidence and requesting preservation and disclosure of surviving records so the history can be properly examined.

Please treat this correspondence as a request to preserve any surviving archival material pending further enquiries.

[Other personal context and contact details omitted from this public-safe extract.]

I am writing concerning the woodland area at Great House Farm / Tŷ Mawr Farm, Llandough-juxta-Penarth, near St Dochdwy's Church and the later Church View Close development.

[Other ownership-history and personal context from the original message is omitted from this public-safe extract.]

records.transcript:
Dear Companies House,

I request, under the Companies Act and in light of the current temporary pause on destruction of dissolved-company files, the complete surviving files (or certified copies / digital images) for:

- Western Ground Rents Ltd
- BP Properties Ltd
- Ideal Homes Wales (and any Ideal Homes company that held an interest in land at Llandough / Great House Farm)

These files are required for a live title and registration investigation concerning Great House Farm / Tŷ Mawr, Llandough. Please confirm preservation of any surviving material and the earliest supply or inspection date.

Yours faithfully,

Sion Buckler (Ret'd Sergeant)
Royal Signals Cyber/Electronic Warfare Professional and Life Member

records.transcript:
Dear Sirs,

I write as Sion Buckler. The original message included links to the public working evidence catalogue, title and chronology index, and long-term archive; those external addresses are omitted from this public-safe transcript.

BP Properties Ltd v Buckler concerned Great House Farm (Tŷ Mawr), Llandough-juxta-Penarth. Possession was obtained on 29 November 1988; the outbuildings were demolished on 30 November 1988 and the farmhouse on 5–6 December 1988. Before considering any litigation, I am exhausting all non-litigious avenues and placing preservation notices with every party that may hold records or artefacts.

If your firm acted for BP Properties Ltd, the BP Pension Trust or any related entity in that matter, please preserve and do not destroy any client files, correspondence, court bundles, title documents, photographs, plans or other material relating to Great House Farm / Tŷ Mawr for 1969 to present. Please confirm in writing whether you hold any such material and that a preservation hold is in place.

Kind regards,

Sion Buckler (Ret'd Sergeant)
Royal Signals Cyber/Electronic Warfare Professional and Life Member
